data.title: 角楯花凛 · 浴后套房的深蓝真丝浴袍
data.description: 高级套房热气蒸腾的更衣室外，刚沐浴完毕的花凛身披一袭深蓝真丝长浴袍靠坐在长椅上。深色系带松松系在腰间，若隐若现展现出如黑曜石般匀称健美的小麦色肌肤与深邃锁骨。湿漉的黑发搭在肩头，金色兽瞳中漾着难得的惬意与动情，少言寡语的王牌女仆在只有两人的空间里展露着极致的诱惑。
data.location: luxurious suite dressing lounge beside steamy bathroom
data.action: reclining comfortably on plush lounge chair, deep navy silk bathrobe loosely tied, dark skin glistening, wet dark hair, golden eyes looking at viewer with calm allure
data.lighting: warm amber downlighting reflecting off glossy silk and dewy skin
data.mood: sultry exotic elegance, quiet protective intimacy
data.promptProse: Reclining on a lounge chair after a hot bath, Kakudate Karin wears a deep navy silk bathrobe tied loosely at the waist. Her dark skin glistens in warm lamplight as she gazes forward with calm, sultry golden eyes.
data.animaCaption: Karin reclining in a dark silk bathrobe after a bath, her dark skin glistening softly.
